label: Roncesvalles Ave at Galley Ave
title: Roncesvalles pedestrian crossing
description: View along Roncesvalles Avenue looking south on a smoky day in July 2026. A pedestrian activates flashing lights at the Galley Avenue PXO and crosses the street as a car waits. Another car starts parallel parking. The intersection is in process of being converted to full traffic signals but it hasn't been finished yet -- new traffic light poles and some wrapped signal heads can be seen.
